headline: ARI @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 4.82 at STL 4.44, with a projected total of 9.26. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: ARI moved +0.76 runs while STL moved +0.12, changing the projected margin by +0.65 runs. The projected total climbed +0.88, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -5.4%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Eduardo Rodriguez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alec Burleson, Ketel Marte, Gabriel Moreno, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ildemaro Vargas because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
